collaborative_model: randomized truncated SVD of training-user, pre-cutoff rating-minus-item-prior residuals; missing entries zero
item_feature_scaling: unit row norm, with intercept; same ridge penalty as genre model
candidate_control: all four methods share CF-generated candidates per budget; do not attribute cross-representation differences to reranking alone
exact_scope: first 128 dev users by sample_key, all three history budgets, both genre and collaborative representations
exact_objective: finite-bootstrap setwise minimax regret via threshold set-cover MILP; point-score sum is secondary tie objective
unknown_feasibility: retain bounds; never classify timeout or solver error as infeasible
do_not: claim SVD/MMR/SMR as a new method
claim mixed-strategy equilibrium from deterministic minimax optimization
